title: Right Place, Right Time
cn: 第 22 集 · 对的时间，对的地点
novel:
Ted [[explained|explain]] how a [[series|series]] of [[coincidences|coincidence]] led to meeting Stella. Every step was [[accidental|accidental]], yet every step was [[crucial|crucial]].

It started with a [[rainstorm|rainstorm]]. Ted ducked into a [[doorway|doorway]] and met a stranger. The stranger recommended a restaurant. Ted went, and there he met Stella.

"If it hadn't rained, I wouldn't have met her," Ted said. "If the stranger hadn't spoken, I wouldn't have gone. If I hadn't gone, I wouldn't have met Stella."

Barney listened skeptically. "That's not [[destiny|destiny]]. That's just [[probability|probability]]."

But Ted was [[convinced|convince]]. Every moment was a [[turning|turning]] point. Every [[encounter|encounter]] was a [[link|link]] in a [[chain|chain]].

"Think about it," Ted said. "How did we all meet? Marshall and I were [[roommates|roommate]]. Lily was Marshall's girlfriend. Barney was in the same bar. Robin walked in one night."

Each meeting was a [[remarkable|remarkable]] [[sequence|sequence]] of events.

Marshall [[agreed|agree]]. "It's like a [[puzzle|puzzle]]. Every piece [[matters|matter]]."

Lily [[smiled|smile]]. "Or maybe we're just lucky."

Ted [[shrugged|shrug]]. "Either way, I'm [[grateful|grateful]] for every [[accident|accident]] that brought us here."

The gang sat together at MacLaren's, [[pondering|ponder]] the [[mystery|mystery]] of fate and chance. Some things, they [[realized|realize]], were meant to be.

series.en: a number of things in order

coincidence.en: when things happen by chance in a surprising way

rainstorm.en: a heavy fall of rain with wind

doorway.en: the entrance to a building or room

destiny.en: the things that will happen to you in the future

probability.en: how likely something is to happen

turning.en: a point where things change direction

roommate.en: someone you share a room with

sequence.en: things that follow one after another

puzzle.en: a game where you put pieces together

smile.en: to raise the corners of your mouth

mystery.en: something that is hard to understand
